Specification: This module specifies and model checks a fast mutual exclusion algorithm for N processes, originally written in PlusCal and translated to TLA+. Each process repeatedly tries to enter a critical section using shared variables x, y, and an array b of intent flags, together with local state j and failed to coordinate retries and detect failed attempts. The specification defines the initial state, individual control-location actions, a global Next action, a standard temporal Spec with weak fairness for every process action, a mutual exclusion invariant, and a liveness property asserting that some process enters the critical section infinitely often.
IfThenElse: IF y # 0 THEN /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "l4"] ELSE /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "l6"]
IF x # self THEN /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "l8"] ELSE /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "cs"]
IF (j[self] \leq N) THEN /\ ~b[j[self]] /\ j' = [j EXCEPT ![self] = j[self]+1] /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "l9"] ELSE /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "l10"] /\ j' = j
IF y # self THEN /\ y = 0 /\ failed' = [failed EXCEPT ![self] = TRUE] ELSE /\ TRUE /\ UNCHANGED failed
IF ~ failed[self] THEN /\ TRUE /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "l11"] /\ UNCHANGED failed ELSE /\ failed' = [failed EXCEPT ![self] = FALSE] /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "start"]
TupleConstructor: << pc, x, y, b, j, failed >>
UnchangedExprs: UNCHANGED << x, y, b, j, failed >>
